My first trip abroad, changing planes in Warsaw for Munich. As the only Asian on the plane, I stood out a mile.

The young German woman next to me, perhaps out of curiosity, struck up a conversation. She said she wanted a lip tattoo, a five-letter word. Did I have any suggestions?

The first thing that came to mind was bitch. Just as it was about to leap out of my mouth, reason won out, and I blurted out queen instead.

She stared at me for ages, speechless. Maybe she didn’t quite get it =_=

In hindsight, bitch would have been far more explosive!
